evaluation_principles: Judge searcher intent semantically, not by mere lexical score.
Never claim observed autocomplete terms have measurable search volume.
A prototype should not advertise live waiter dispatch, payments, integrations, or pricing.
Preserve rejected terms as evidence of irrelevant directions.
All statuses are provisional until live SERP or customer evidence.
